title: [Main]-[Escalated] [Strategic] [BC-IN]Online: Performance issue in General journal line from June 17th 2026 - 2606170030006074
summary: Removed a redundant CurrPage.SaveRecord() call from 31 India journal and voucher page extensions in the GST, TCS, TDS and Tax Base apps. The extra call caused a database write and a workflow evaluation for every line, which made line entry slow. Tax calculation is unchanged.
key_points: Removes one redundant CurrPage.SaveRecord() line from each of 31 page extensions
Affects General, Cash Receipt, Payment, Purchase and Sales journals and Bank and Cash vouchers in INGST, INTCS, INTDS and INTaxBase
Avoids an extra database write and workflow evaluation per journal line
Fixes lag that was worse in environments with many enabled workflows
Tax calculation behaviour is stated to be unchanged
